previous_discovery: Original fixed 437 public Movebank package census, 259 GPS/GNSS sensor-labelled, 159 canonical original GPS CSV headers, original source header artifact https://github.com/zuizui0223/odsp/actions/runs/40164787562
selection_rule: Among public canonical original GPS CSV source-header packages with ORIGINAL source file >=1,000,000 and <=80,000,000 bytes, provider checksum metadata, nonempty original repository study ID and EXACT ONE distinct literal nonhuman scientific-name label, exclude all previously selected 45 original source UUIDs and any shared original repository study ID. The preserved header audit left 89 eligible nonhuman one-species original file metadata packages; rank SHA256(UTF8('odsp-solar-weather-outer-validation-20261025-v0:'+package_uuid)) ascending; take FIRST 24 distinct taxon names and distinct original repository study IDs, without replacement. Human data excluded before outcomes for ethics and to target nonhuman animal ecology; domestic/feral nonhuman animals kept but must not be described as wild taxa.
original_source_manifest_intent: For EACH of 24 sources verify sole provider ORIGINAL .csv bitstream file, frozen ORIGINAL source byte size, original provider MD5/SHA checksum and exact canonical taxon/study ID before reading event rows; preserve all source HODs; never substitute next-ranked source or prefer favorable result.
original_tracking_observations: Original UTC timestamp, individual-local-identifier, location-lat and location-long. Single published source taxon, verify original row source taxon label if available. Time-only choose nearest original GPS fix per tagged animal and UTC hour; original consecutive 0.5–2h steps >=100m <=60 kmph, geometric sun elevation >=10 degrees at start/midpoint/end, one solar day. Do not export raw GPS tracks, IDs, cell centers or exact event timestamps.
modal_environmental_frame: PREDECLARED identical to exploratory 24-source programme: for original source taxon top TWO 1-degree lat×lon×UTC calendar year grid contexts selected by highest distinct tagged animal support then original daylight step count, no sun effect sign or weather value; require >=3 animals, >=30 qualified steps, >=3 original solar dates and original year 1940–2025. Unavailable siteyears are not replaced.
ERA5: Public Open-Meteo Historical ERA5 explicitly models=era5, UTC full original year, wind_speed_100m, wind_direction_100m, shortwave_radiation, temperature_2m, identical source code and units, 1° grid center, original GPS midpoint UTC floored hour; weather source body hashes retained, no raw model arrays or source gridpoint positions redistributed.
primary_hypothesis: In held-out original-source study archives, higher original same-hour ERA5 surface shortwave radiation is associated with LOWER solar-relative GPS travel alignment (cos(Bearing−SunAzimuth)), conditional on original tagged individual, UTC month and apparent solar four-hour clock bin.
primary_effect_units: Within-animal signed univariate weather regression of cos(GPS travel−Sun) per +100 W/m² ERA5 surface shortwave, centered separately within tagged individual × month × four-hour apparent solar-time blocks: >=8 original weather-linked steps and >=3 dates per block, >=2 qualifying blocks and 20 observations/animal, predictor SD >=60 W/m²; >=5 qualifying animals for a source siteyear. Equal selected siteyears within single taxon source then equal ORIGINAL source study archive.
primary_test: Source-block descriptive bootstrap (2000 source-ID resamples, deterministic random seed 20261025) of equal-source mean. Declare directional replication SUPPORTED only if at least 6 different held-out archive source-study IDs support a radiative slope, all 24 original outcomes/source holds are retained, and the 95% original-study bootstrap upper endpoint is <0. Otherwise result NOT SUPPORTED or INSUFFICIENT_SOURCE_SUPPORT. This is a conditional heldout source-sample criterion, NOT a formal population-representative confirmatory p-value.
secondary_exploratory: In same original siteyears mean cos(GPS bearing−100m wind flow TO), mean cos(wind flow TO−solar bearing), modelled weather mean 100m wind, shortwave, 2m T.

Within-animal month×solar-hour weather associations of source sunward cosine with 100m windspeed, wind-solar geometry and 2m T; separate original-source mean slopes with source-block descriptive intervals, no selective direction claim.
distinction: The first 24 original-source wind/shortwave slope results were used to formulate the primary negative direction. This new source roster was selected before original GPS or weather observations of these source packages, from a pre-existing public header-compatible archive list and is not a reanalysis of published effect sizes. Source studies may share real underlying field populations even when Movebank study IDs differ; no claim of truly independent ecological regions without GIS provenance.
limits: Within-hour and within-month astronomical sun altitude and local route/foraging confounds remain. Modeled ERA5 hourly surface shortwave is not direct animal irradiance; windy cloud weather and movement behavior jointly change. One-sided source resampling is descriptive, not a causal effect nor a worldwide independent study sampling likelihood. Previous source weather raw response hashes not archived as bytes, later refetch may differ.
privacy: No exact animal positions/timestamps, GPS tracks, UTC-hour weather grid locations, or animal IDs in publications or GitHub logs; only source-group counts, coarse hemisphere latitude bands, annual frame and source-weather hashed receipts.
